name: harness-sdk-host-node
description: Node SDK starter that runs AgentPM Harness through a hosted model, Hook, and approval controller.

variables.name: project_name
variables.description: Generated project name. Generation-time only; do not use for API keys, tokens, passwords, or runtime secrets.

variables.name: workspace_label
variables.description: Human-readable label shown in the generated README, Harness config, and terminal output.

variables.name: default_user_scope
variables.description: Default user scope supplied by the SDK client when it launches Harness.

entrypoints.label: Run the SDK-hosted Harness example
entrypoints.command: pnpm dev -- "Use the SDK-hosted Harness example to inspect this generated workspace."
